tooltip.synbio.plasmid.empty: Empty plasmid. Insert a genetic part first.
tooltip.synbio.protein.gfp: 2008 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. GFP lets scientists 'see' gene expression — green glow = it's working. Right-click to scan plasmids/bacteria in your inventory for diagnostic info.
tooltip.synbio.protein.keratin: Primary component of hair, nails, and rhino horn. Nature's most common structural protein — strong yet flexible. Smithing Table → armor enhancement.
tooltip.synbio.protein.myosin: The molecular motor that drives muscle contraction. Every heartbeat, every step — myosin 'walking' on ATP. Smithing Table → sword +damage / boots +speed.
tooltip.synbio.protein.telomerase: 2009 Nobel Prize. Maintains telomeres — protective caps on chromosomes — slowing cellular aging. Also linked to cancer's immortality. Smithing Table → tool/armor repair.
tooltip.synbio.protein.spider_silk: 5× stronger than steel by weight, tougher than Kevlar. Synthetic biology aims to mass-produce it sustainably, replacing petrochemical fibers. Smithing Table → bow enhancement.
tooltip.synbio.protein.luciferase: The secret behind firefly light. Luciferase + luciferin + O₂ = 'cold light' at nearly 100% efficiency. Biology's favorite reporter enzyme. Smithing Table → helmet night vision.
tooltip.synbio.protein.petase: A bacterial enzyme discovered in 2016 at a Japanese recycling plant. It digests PET plastic — synthetic biology's hope against global plastic pollution. Right-click blocks → recycle.
tooltip.synbio.protein.ice_nucleation: From Pseudomonas syringae bacteria. Catalyzes ice formation at -2°C (pure water needs -40°C). Used in artificial snowmaking and climate research. Smithing Table → boots Frost Walker.
tooltip.synbio.gfp.no_constructs: §7No genetic constructs detected. Place engineered plasmids or bacteria in your offhand or hotbar.§r
tooltip.synbio.petase.cannot_recycle: §7PETase cannot recycle this block. Try glass, wool, or terracotta.§r
tooltip.synbio.petase.recycled: §aPETase degraded the block into raw materials!§r
tooltip.synbio.waste_culture: Bio-lab waste containing genetically engineered microbes. Dispose properly (smelt in furnace). Accumulation causes lab contamination!
tooltip.synbio.waste_culture.danger: §c⚠ Too much waste culture is piling up nearby! You feel sick... Clean it up!§r
synbio.guide.title: SynBio Crafter Guide
synbio.guide.page.0:
§l§6Welcome to Synthetic Biology!§r

This guide teaches you real molecular
biology workflows in Minecraft.

Turn the page to begin.

§8— Peking HSC iGEM 2026 §r
synbio.guide.page.1:
§lWhat is Synthetic Biology?§r

Engineering meets biology — design
and build living systems like LEGO.

Core idea: §6Standardization§r —
DNA parts work like electronic
components, freely combinable.
synbio.guide.page.2:
§lDNA, Genes & Proteins§r

§6DNA§r — blueprint of life
(A, T, C, G bases in a helix)

§6Gene§r — segment coding a protein

§6Protein§r — functional molecule
Keratin→hair, Myosin→muscle,
GFP→jellyfish glow
synbio.guide.page.3:
§lCentral Dogma§r

§6DNA → RNA → Protein§r

§6Transcription§r:
DNA → mRNA (by RNA polymerase)

§6Translation§r:
mRNA → Protein (by ribosomes)

§dSINEB2§r: boosts translation —
this mod's signature element!
synbio.guide.page.4:
§lQuick Pipeline Guide§r

① Kill mobs → Unknown Tissue
② Crafting → identify DNA parts
③ Plasmid Assembler → plasmid
④ Wild E. coli + CaCl₂ → competent
⑤ Competent + plasmid → engineered
⑥ Engineered + broth → protein
⑦ Protein + Smithing → enhancement!

§8(Each page has exact recipes)§r
synbio.guide.page.5:
§lPipeline (continued)§r

§6Wild E. coli§r:
Dirt + Glass Bottle + Sugar = ×1

§6Calcium Chloride§r:
Stone + Water Bucket = ×4

§6Crafting Sequence:§r
Wild → Competent → Engineered
→ Protein (in Crafting Table)

§8Lost this book?§r
Book + Blank Plasmid = ×1
synbio.guide.page.6:
§l① Blank Plasmid§r

§6Auto§r: Get 1 on first join.
§6Craft§r: 1 Paper + 1 Redstone
Dust → 1 Blank Plasmid
§6Stack§r: 16

A §6plasmid§r is a circular DNA
molecule. It's the 'vehicle' for
carrying genes into bacteria.
synbio.guide.page.7:
§l② Collect DNA Parts§r

Kill mobs → Unknown Biological
Tissue (random % drop).

§6Crafting Table§r:
1 Tissue → 1 random DNA part

§6Mob → CDS Drops (50%):§r
GlowSquid→GFP   Zombie→Keratin
Cow→Myosin     Enderman→Telomerase
Spider→SpiderSilk  Blaze→Luciferase
Drowned→PETase Stray→IceNucleation
synbio.guide.page.8:
§lPlasmid Assembler§r

§6Craft:§r
[I][I][I]  I=Iron Ingot
[I][C][I]  C=Crafting Table
[I][I][I]  → 1 Assembler

§6GUI Layout (7 slots):§r
§7[Pro] [5'UTR]§r
§7[CDS] [3'UTR]§r
§7[Enh] [SINEB2]§r
§7[Center: Blank Plasmid]§r

CDS is §6required§r! Higher
rarity = better expression!
synbio.guide.page.9:
§l④ Transformation§r

§6Wild E. coli§r:
Dirt + Bottle + Sugar → §e×1§r

§6Calcium Chloride§r:
Stone + Water Bucket → §e×4§r

§6Competent Cells§r:
1 Wild + 1 CaCl₂ → 1 Competent

§6Transformation§r:
1 Competent + 1 Engineered
Plasmid → 1 Engineered E. coli
§8(Plasmid is NOT consumed)§r
synbio.guide.page.10:
§l⑤ Nutrient Broth Recipes§r

§2Green§r: 1 Fe + 4 Wheat + 4 Sugar
→ §e×8 Broth§r  [Tier 1]

§1Blue§r: 8 Green around Prismarine/
Glow Berries → §e×8§r  [T1-2]

§5Purple§r: 8 Blue around Ender Pearl/
Chorus/Blaze → §e×8§r  [T1-3]

§6Gold§r: 8 Purple around
Golden Apple → §e×8§r  [T1-4]
synbio.guide.page.11:
§l⑤ Express Proteins§r

§6Crafting Table:§r
1 Engineered E. coli
+ 1 Nutrient Broth
→ 1 Protein + 1 Waste
(Broth consumed, bacteria kept)

§6Broth Tier = Max Protein:§r
Green→T1, Blue→T1-2,
Purple→T1-3, Gold→T1-4

§8Incubator also works:§r
8Fe+2Glass+1Furnace→1Incubator
synbio.guide.page.12:
§l⑥ Bio-Enhancements (Combat)§r

Put protein + gear in Smithing Table

§6Myosin-Sword§r: +1/+3/+5/+10 dmg
§6Myosin-Boots§r: +3/5/8/12% speed
§6Keratin§r: Tough+KB resist;
T3=+1 armor, T4=+2
§6Telomerase§r: T1-3=Unbreaking;
§eT4=Unbreakable+Mending§r
§6Spider Silk-Bow§r: Power I-IV
synbio.guide.page.13:

§6Luciferase-Helmet§r:
15s/30s/60s/§e∞§r night vision

§6Ice Nucleation-Boots§r:
Frost Walker I/I/II/II

§2GFP§r: Right-click → scan

§2PETase§r: Right-click block →
Glass→Sand, Wool→String,

synbio.guide.page.14:
§lBiosafety§r

§ciGEM: responsible science!§r

§6Waste Culture§r:
Every expression produces waste.
§c≥10§r in 32 blocks = Poison!
§c≥30§r = Poison + Nausea!

§6Disposal§r: Furnace → Bone Meal
(Like real autoclave sterilization)

Always dispose of lab waste!
synbio.guide.page.15:
§lTips & Credits§r

• 9 same-rarity parts → upgrade
• Plasmid assembler keeps design
• Higher tier = better multiplier
• Use GFP to diagnose plasmids
• PETase recycles blocks into raw
